ruleset.name: nitpicker-guards
ruleset.description: Nitpicker's own PMD rules for main sources.

rule.name: OptionalGet
rule.message: Use orElseThrow(), orElse(...), map or ifPresent instead of Optional.get(), also after isPresent().

rule.name: OptionalAsFieldOrParameter
rule.message: Do not use Optional as a field, parameter or record component. Take the plain value (or add an overload) and return Optional only from methods.
rule.description: Optional is a return type, not state or an argument.

rule.name: OptionalOfCollection
rule.message: Return an empty collection instead of an Optional of a collection.
rule.description: An empty collection already means nothing was found.

rule.name: InstanceofThenCast
rule.message: Use pattern matching (x instanceof Circle c) or a switch over a sealed type instead of instanceof followed by a cast.
rule.description: A cast after instanceof repeats the type test; pattern matching does both.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //InfixExpression[@Operator = 'instanceof'][TypeExpression/ClassType][VariableAccess] [not(ancestor::UnaryExpression[@Operator = '!'])] [let $instanceof := ., $type := TypeExpression/ClassType/@SimpleName, $variable := VariableAccess/@Name return ancestor::*[self::IfStatement or self::ConditionalExpression or self::InfixExpression[@Operator = '&&']] [*[1]/descendant-or-self::*[. is $instanceof]]/*[2]/descendant-or-self::*/CastExpression [ClassType[@SimpleName = $type][not(TypeArguments/*[not(self::WildcardType)])]][VariableAccess/@Name = $variable]]

rule.name: SneakyThrows
rule.message: Declare the checked exception or wrap it in a specific unchecked exception. @SneakyThrows hides it from callers.
rule.description: @SneakyThrows throws checked exceptions without declaring them.

rule.name: SwallowedInterruptedException
rule.message: Restore the interrupt with Thread.currentThread().interrupt() or rethrow when catching InterruptedException.
rule.description: Swallowing InterruptedException hides a cancellation request.

rule.name: CollectorsToList
rule.message: Use Stream.toList(). For a mutable result use collect(Collectors.toCollection(ArrayList::new)).
rule.description: Stream.toList() is the short form of collect(Collectors.toList()).

rule.name: StreamResourceNotClosed
rule.message: Open Files.lines, list, walk and find in try-with-resources, or return the stream to a caller that does: the stream holds a file handle.
rule.description: A file stream that is never closed leaks a file handle.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('java.nio.file.Files#lines(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.nio.file.Files#list(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.nio.file.Files#walk(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.nio.file.Files#find(_*)')] [not(ancestor::Resource)] [let $top := ancestor-or-self::MethodCall[not(parent::MethodCall/*[1] is .)][1], $scope := ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration or self::Initializer or self::LambdaExpression][1], $name := ($top/parent::VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name, $top/parent::AssignmentExpression/VariableAccess[1]/@Name)[1] return not($top[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.stream.BaseStream')][parent::*[self::ReturnStatement or self::LambdaExpression]]) and not(exists($name) and ($scope//Resource/VariableAccess[@Name = $name] or $scope//MethodCall[@MethodName = 'close'][*[1][self::VariableAccess[@Name = $name]]]))]

rule.name: ForEachSideEffect
rule.message: Do not change a captured collection, array or field inside a stream forEach or peek. Build the result with map(...) and collect or toList(), or use a for loop.
rule.description: Side effects on shared state inside a stream pipeline are order-dependent and unsafe in parallel streams.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $mutators := ('add', 'addAll', 'put', 'putAll', 'putIfAbsent', 'append', 'offer', 'push', 'merge', 'compute', 'computeIfAbsent', 'computeIfPresent', 'remove', 'set', 'addFirst', 'addLast', 'increment', 'incrementAndGet', 'getAndIncrement') return //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('forEach', 'forEachOrdered', 'peek')][*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.stream.BaseStream')]]/ArgumentList/( LambdaExpression[let $lambda := . return ( .//MethodCall[@MethodName = $mutators][*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess]] [not(*[1]/@Name = $lambda//VariableId/@Name)] | .//AssignmentExpression[not(*[1]/descendant-or-self::*[self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess][1]/@Name = $lambda//VariableId/@Name)] | .//UnaryExpression[@Operator = ('++', '--')] [not(*[1]/descendant-or-self::*[self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess][1]/@Name = $lambda//VariableId/@Name)])] | MethodReference[@MethodName = $mutators][*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess]] )

rule.name: SqlConcatenation
rule.message: Pass values to the database as ? parameters of a PreparedStatement; never build SQL with + or String.format. A table or column name checked against a fixed list can be intended.
rule.description: String-built SQL is open to injection.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall[ pmd-java:matchesSig('java.sql.Statement#executeQuery(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.sql.Statement#execute(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.sql.Statement#executeUpdate(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.sql.Statement#executeLargeUpdate(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.sql.Statement#addBatch(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.sql.Connection#prepareStatement(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.sql.Connection#prepareCall(_*)')] /ArgumentList/*[1][ self::InfixExpression[@Operator = '+'][@CompileTimeConstant = false()] or self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('format', 'formatted', 'concat', 'join')]]

rule.name: WeakHash
rule.message: Use SHA-256 or stronger; for passwords use a password encoder such as bcrypt or Argon2. MD5 and SHA-1 can be intended for a checksum or ETag that protects nothing.
rule.description: MD5 and SHA-1 collide and are fast to brute force.

rule.name: NestedQuantifierRegex
rule.message: This regex can backtrack exponentially: a repeated group repeats an item that is itself repeated, as in (a+)+ or (a|aa)+. Remove the inner or the outer quantifier.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.regex.Pattern#compile(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.regex.Pattern#matches(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.String#matches(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.String#replaceAll(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.String#replaceFirst(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.String#split(_*)')] /ArgumentList/*[1][self::StringLiteral] [matches(@Image, '\((\?:)?(\\\\.|\[[^\]]*\]|[^()|\\\[\]*+?{}])[*+]\??((\\\\.|\[[^\]]*\]|[^()|\\\[\]*+?{}])[*?]\??)*\)([*+]|\{\d+,\})') or matches(@Image, '\((\?:)?(\\\\.|\[[^\]]*\]|[^()|\\\[\]*+?{}])\|\2[*+]?\2?\)([*+]|\{\d+,\})')]

rule.name: PathFromParameter
rule.message: Resolve the path against a fixed base directory, then call normalize() and check startsWith(base) before using it.
rule.description: A path built from a method parameter can escape the base directory with ../.

property.name: xpath
property.value: ( //MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('java.nio.file.Path#of(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.nio.file.Paths#get(_*)')][count(ArgumentList/*) >= 2] | //ConstructorCall[pmd-java:typeIs('java.io.File')][count(ArgumentList/*) = 2] | //MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('java.nio.file.Path#resolve(java.lang.String)')] )[let $method := ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration][1] return $method/@Visibility != 'private' and ArgumentList/*[self::VariableAccess or self::InfixExpression]/descendant-or-self::VariableAccess [@Name = $method/FormalParameters/FormalParameter/VariableId/@Name] and not($method//MethodCall[@MethodName = ('normalize', 'toRealPath', 'getCanonicalPath', 'getCanonicalFile') or @MethodName = 'startsWith' and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.nio.file.Path')]])]

rule.name: SignatureDeclareThrowsException
rule.message: Declare the checked exceptions the method throws (IOException, SQLException or a project exception), not Exception or Throwable.
rule.description: throws Exception forces every caller to catch everything.

rule.message: Throw a specific exception (IllegalArgumentException, IllegalStateException or a project exception), not RuntimeException, Exception, Throwable or Error.
